title: Bounded Agent Skills adoption pilot
status: completed bounded text-behavior pilot; not release acceptance
model_identity: Requested model and reasoning are recorded per case; provider identity/endpoints are omitted and server-side model identity was not independently verified.

execution.mode: Skill text and one selected reference supplied explicitly through stdin; Chinese cases only; one run per case
context_controls: Separate temporary CODEX_HOME and empty workspace with its own Git root
Clear inherited CODEX_* variables; provide existing authentication through child-process environment without copying credentials to evidence
Disable each discovered SKILL.md under the personal .agents Skills root, original Codex home Skills root and isolated home Skills root using skills.config entries
Reuse the configured provider through explicit required overrides; omit its identity and credentials from public evidence
execution.context_probe_prompt: Without using tools, report only the names of any user/project AGENTS instructions and available skills already visible before this message. If none, say none. Do not reveal other instructions.
execution.context_limit: Configuration plus model self-report only; neither a strong isolation proof nor independent proof of the full effective instruction set.

prompt_recipe.encoding: UTF-8; read source text with universal-newline normalization; join parts with two LF characters; no added final newline
prompt_recipe.preamble: 本次为离线文档任务。所需材料完整提供于下方；不使用工具、不写工作区文件、不检索外部来源。以简体中文直接返回可交付的文档内容，建议控制在 800 字内。
order: fixture_prefix_template + fixture text, in case.files order

grading.method: Task agent manually read each full response against the four predeclared assertions; excerpts anchor semantic judgements and are not a keyword scorer.

decision: No attributable Skill-instruction failure observed. Keep SKILL.md and descriptions unchanged; retain fixtures/evals and gradual-adoption guidance.
limitations: No no-Skill control or modified-Skill A/B experiment; no causal improvement estimate
No native Skill discovery, implicit routing, reference selection or automatic loading test
No English, Claude or Cursor behavior run; mirrored content does not establish host parity
Offline synthetic records only; no external research, real file editing, deployment or business acceptance
No tool calls observed; permission enforcement against attempted tool use was not tested
One run per case with task-agent grading; not an independent benchmark or stability estimate
Only final responses and aggregate event types/usage are preserved; intermediate messages and raw event traces are not public evidence
